visualization.name: Smiles Drawer
visualization.description: Visualize molecular structures from SMILES notation
visualization.help:
# SmilesDrawer
Visualizes **2D molecular structures** from SMILES (Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System) notation.
## Supported format - `.smi` — SMILES files (one SMILES string per line, optionally followed by a molecule name)
## Usage Select a dataset containing SMILES strings and open it with this visualization. The viewer will render each molecule as a 2D structural diagram on an HTML5 canvas.
To learn more about SmilesDrawer, visit: [https://github.com/reymond-group/smilesDrawer](https://github.com/reymond-group/smilesDrawer)
